title: Refuse overlapping runs of the same checks (Greg: same tests must not run concurrently)
outcome: From Greg's decision after the tm-ncc6.8.6 consultation (Termal::Codex, Termal::Fable, 2026-09-27). Today nothing stops a second run in the same worktree (execution.lock only guards one run dir; 'one run per worktree' is slice-3 admission, tm-ncc6.3.3). Decide the key first, Greg's call: the worktree alone (stricter than his rule; it also refuses a different focused check) or worktree plus plan (full vs focused argv). Requirements from the consultation: the refusal names the running run's id and directory so the caller can register a wait on it instead of retrying; the lock is released by the index's liveness rule (pid plus creation time, only proof of exit counts), never left for a human to delete after a killed launcher; one lock authority shared by the launcher and slice-3 host admission; atomic acquisition. Not part of the UI/Test Runs correctness patch.
